Dialogs.Dialog: One sheep... two sheep... so many of you...
If you don't go to sleep... I'll gobble you up...
Hurry up and take your bath now...
Hey, I told you not to get in with your clothes on...
Shall I... wash your back for you？
Jugemu, Jugemu, Gokō-no surikire, kaijari... wait, what was next...？
Thousand, million, billion, trillion, quadrillion, quintillion...
It flew... my penguin actually flew...
Hey... what do you like about me？
Insolent fool, laying hands on me like that... mmm...
'Tis fine, 'tis fine... I shall grant thee a reward.
Think nothing of it... think nothing of it...
Mmh, it's okay... just be honest with me？
Hehe, stop, that tickles... Geez, take that!
It's still only this time... Hurry up and be tomorrow♪
Just one more sleep until our date... Mmm, I can't wait.
What should I wear tomorrow？ Better pick it out now...
A date yesterday, today, and tomorrow... If only.
Fufu, all I've been thinking about today is our date.
I want to see you so badly. I can't wait till tomorrow...
Tomorrow is our super fun, happy daaaate day♪
Maybe I'll really go all out spoiling you tomorrow. Hehe▼
I hope I look prettier tomorrow than ever before...
If my heart's racing this much already, what's going to happen tomorrow？
Maybe I'll take the lead on our next date？
Haaah... I've been basking in our date ever since.
I want to go back to that place from yesterday with you...
The face you made yesterday... Fufu, you're so cute...
Whenever I remember yesterday, my face gets so hot...
I thought a guy's room would be a lot messier.
Your room's so cozy, though. I could stay forever...
If you'd told me you wouldn't let me leave yesterday, I...
Maybe I'll call for a break. Or would I just bother you...？
Right before exams, you always want to clean your room...？
I wonder if you're working hard right now... I've gotta do my best, too.
Maybe we could focus better if we studied together...
He looked so focused and handsome when he was studying...
Even though I was right next to him yesterday... *sigh*...
Oh gosh, just thinking about tomorrow makes me grin.
I wish tomorrow would hurry up and get here. I can't wait...
...Oh no, here I go thinking about tomorrow again.
That kiss made me so happy...
We just kissed, but my lips feel lonely already...
Now I'm remembering... what we did yesterday...
I love him so much... I don't think I could possibly love him any more.
He can be so bold sometimes...
He's such a good kisser, too...
After a kiss like that, I'm gonna dream about it...
Phew... I almost thought he'd eat my lips right up.
I love you so much. No matter how many times I say it, it's not enough...
I want to hug him right now... and have him hold me, too...
Making me fall this hard... You really are trouble▼
I might be the happiest girl in the whole wide world.
These feelings of love... they just won't stop...
I can't even imagine my life without him anymore...
When did I fall this hard for him, anyway？...
I really want to hear his voice...
It feels like the whole world is brighter now...
I wonder what he's up to. I miss him...
...He's not taking me for granted or anything, right？
Maybe I'll just go to the movies all by myself...
Is this what they call a relationship rut...？
What is this nagging, unsettled feeling...？
Maybe I should just eat my feelings away...
I hate you. ...Not really, but still...
If that's how you're gonna be, I've got a plan of my own.
...He still loves me... right？ He has to.
I refuse to believe it's already morning...
I can't... this bed is way too cozy...
Waking him up is nice, but having him wake me up sounds pretty sweet too...
Oh, this is the part I got wrong the other day...
Phew... Took a bit longer than usual.
Mmh, switching to this new body wash was a good call.
He won't know what hit him▼ ...Or so I hope.
I wonder when we can walk home together next...
Oh... Such pretty flowers. I wish we could've seen them together...
Walking home alone used to be totally normal for me...
I wonder if he's having a proper lunch. Making sure it's balanced, or...？
Oh, this turned out great▼ I'll have to make it for him sometime.
Lunch always tastes best when we eat together...
We're on different shifts today, right？ Bummer...
I wonder if he's home yet, or stopping somewhere on the way...？
Things really are better when we're together...
It's already past midnight, you know？ Coming to see me at this hour... You really are a bad boy.
Did you wake up？ Or can't you sleep？ I'll stay right here with you, so you can rest easy.
Good morning. Look at that sleepy face. Come on, perk up now, okay？
Good morning. I wish we could greet each other like this every day. Not just in the morning, but at noon, at night, and at bedtime...
Here starts another day~! Let's give it our all again today♪
Good morning~, it's really morning... I won't wake up unless you give me a good morning kiss.
You get so sleepy around this hour, don't you？ Taking a deep breath helps wake you up, you know？ Breathe way in~, and out~...
*Yawn*... Oh, honestly. Taking a nap after lunch... Wouldn't that be nice？
Looks like I'm sharp today. I had a feeling you were about to show up.
The real day begins after school, doesn't it？ Wonder what we should do now.
Want to take a short break？ Don't push yourself too hard, okay？ Just relax, relax.
Good work today. Think you can take it easy tonight？ Let me join you, okay？
Did anything nice happen today？ Even the smallest little thing, I'd love to hear about it.
I try to double-check texts I wrote at night the next morning. You get a bit too bold at night, you know...
Did you brush your teeth？ Wash your face？ If you're too sloppy, I'll have to punish you.
You came to see me at this hour. Going to sleep feels like such a waste, so maybe I'll stay up a bit longer.
I was just having a dream about you.
When I can't sleep, I look outside. It's pitch-black, but somehow it calms me.
I missed you so much I thought I'd lose my mind. I really, truly missed you...
We've been together so much lately. I don't know if I could be without you now...
Maybe this is a bit too adventurous...？
This works too, right？ ...Or maybe not.
He complimented that color before, so maybe something in this shade too...？
This length takes forever to style, though...
Maybe it needs one more little touch...？
Mmm, the silhouette just isn't working.
I wonder if he'd like something like this...？
Oh right, think I'll send him a text...
Did I text him about that already？ Let's see...
Guess I'll send a text just in case...
Oh, there it is! Perfect timing▼
Coming! I'll open it right up...
Hmm, whatever, good enough. Sending it!
Oh, right, gotta do this before I forget...
Ngh, my back... Am I getting stiff？
Ow... It got in my eye...
No way, it went up a bit？ And I was being so careful~.
Oh, my waist looks a bit slimmer! Keep it up, keep it up▼
Wait, it went down! I knew it~♪
Maybe I should cut back on eating out. Nutrition's probably all out of whack...
I've been cutting back on eating out, though...
One bite of this and he'll be completely hooked.
Hehe, it's perfection▼ Maybe I'll make it for him sometime.
Something's missing... Wonder what it is...？
Wait, but I followed the recipe to the letter...
I think the one I made the other day was better...
Oh, this is turning out better than last time. Hehe♪
A boxed lunch really needs a little color too, huh？
Maybe I packed a little too much love into it. Hehe.
Should I draw a heart...？ What should I do？▼
I hope he likes his lunch...
All right! Time to try out a new recipe.
I messed up last time... Lesson learned, lesson learned.
I gotta do my best so he'll praise me again.
Aw, cute! ...Or is it a little too cute for me？
Huh, you can wear it like that too...
You don't see this color very often...
Oh, this looks just like his. Matching outfits？ Hehe...
This looks nice. Maybe I'll wait for it to go on sale...
Wow, looks delicious. Wonder if I could make it...？
Hmm, gathering all the ingredients might be tough.
This might make a good side dish for lunch...
Oh, he'd probably like this. I wanna make it for him...
Presentation is important in cooking, too...
I wonder if he's eating right now too...
Nnngh... All right, let's do our best today!
Hm？ Felt a certain someone looking at me, but maybe it's just my imagination...
Huh？ Weird... I could've sworn I felt his presence...
Hmm, I definitely feel eyes on me, but... he couldn't be here, right？
Are you busy right now？ If you've got time, wanna talk for a bit？
I wanna hear your voice. Come on, let's talk？
I want to talk with you. Come on, please？
What are you doing right now？ Something difficult？
Did you just laugh？ Did something funny happen？
Just looking at your face warms my heart.
You know, there's a place I want to go with you. Will you take me there？
Hey, look over here？ Hehe, did I interrupt you？
What's up？ You have that look like you want to say something.
If anything's bothering you, tell me about it, okay？ Getting it off your chest will make you feel better.
You look so serious. Come on, smile for me!
That look on your face... You're up to something, aren't you？
Hey, do you ever talk about me to your friends？
Hehe, that look on your face is kind of cute.
Hey, doesn't it smell nice？ I wonder what it is...
When you smile, your eyes get so gentle, you know？
Something wrong？ Tell me about it？
...I love you. Ah, you've got that "I already know" look.
I want you to say my name. ...Over and over.
I'm always cheering for you, you know？ Just don't push yourself too hard, okay？
I see. Thanks for telling me.
Is that so？ And then？ I want to hear more.
...Ah, sorry. Your voice just felt so soothing.
Mm-hmm. I know what you mean...
Maybe you didn't hear me？ You look busy, so I'll come back later, okay？
Looks like you're busy. Too bad, I'll talk to you later.
Are you in the zone？ Sorry for interrupting, okay？
Let me know when you're free. I'll be waiting.
Let's wrap it up for today. Otherwise we'll never stop.
Aww, done already？ Let's chat again soon, okay？
I could talk forever, but... let's call it a day, okay？
I'm not done talking yet... Hehe, but I'll let you off the hook for now.
Phew... I'd love to keep talking, but let's save it for next time.
You seem like you're doing great lately. That's the vibe I'm getting from you.
Right？ I can tell just from your vibe these days▼
Really？ Well, things are gonna get so much better from now on. I guarantee it!
Hey, did something good happen to you recently？
I knew it! Seeing you like that makes me happy too.
Really？ Even something tiny, try to think back？
How are you doing lately？ Just so-so, maybe？
I see. If anything's wrong, talk to me, okay？ Bottling it up is the worst thing you can do.
Then I'll cast a little spell to make you feel better. Bad stuff, bad stuff, fly away~! ...How's that？
You don't seem to be feeling too well, are you okay？ Maybe it's just my imagination.
At times like that, you just come be spoiled by me. It'll cheer you right up, okay？
If it was just my imagination, that's fine. Fufu, what a relief. Having you full of energy is what matters most▼
Take it easy all day today, okay？ I think that'd be best for you.
When I make an effort to wake up early on a day off, it really hits me how long the day is. Maybe I just sleep too much normally.
I woke up to the sound of birds singing this morning. It made me feel so elegant.
On mornings off, even after waking up, it feels like such a waste to get out of bed, so you just can't bring yourself to move, can you？
This morning, I jumped out of bed thinking I forgot to set my alarm. Fufu, even though it's my day off.
This morning, Type O was number one on the TV blood type horoscope. It said three good things would happen today.
I ate a really big breakfast this morning. But doing that keeps me energized all day. Are you eating properly, too？
Morning gym class is rough since your body isn't awake yet, you know？ Though the afternoon has its own kind of fatigue...
Has your stomach ever growled during class？ Today, I pretended to cough to cover it up. That's our little secret, okay？
I woke up early this morning, but I got to see the sunrise. The sky was golden, it was so pretty...
I love having natto on rice in the morning, but... thinking about being around you, it's a little... you know.
For lunchtime tea, I usually go with a strong Darjeeling. I'm pretty particular about my black tea, you know.
I'm going to clean from top to bottom today. I really want a steam mop...
I meant to throw away some old magazines, but I ended up flipping through them... In the end, they're still right where they were.
I went to the mall with my mom earlier. She even bought me some clothes♪
My friends keep asking me to introduce you to them, but... the timing for that kind of thing is tricky, isn't it？
The teacher praised me today for being so attentive. It feels like they're never watching, but they really notice everything.
A friend of mine who was texting during class got her phone taken away. She got it back right away, but you be careful too, okay？
A friend was doodling in their textbook, and it was so funny... I started laughing in class just thinking back on it.
Lately my phone battery has been draining so fast... Hey, next time we get new phones, want to get matching ones？
I heard the empty classroom on the first floor is free for anyone to use during lunch. Did you know that？
Doesn't looking at the sunset just soothe you？ Sometimes, I love brewing some tea, putting on some music, and just zoning out to the sunset.
I sometimes get sleepy around this time, but if I nap now, I won't be able to sleep tonight. So I have to resist, resist...
I went and bought two fashion magazines▼ Now I'm gonna study them from cover to cover.
Someone gave me cough drops as a souvenir from abroad. You know, they have so many unique throat drops overseas？
Here's a hot tip. If you head to the school store after class, they sometimes sell leftover pastries for half price. Did you know that？
Sometimes I accidentally show up to work even when I'm not scheduled. It must be out of habit...
On days I don't work, I go grocery shopping around 5. Going after the discount hour, of course. Don't you think I'd make a good wife？
When I get home from school, I always think I should review and prep, but... well. I do do my homework, though, you know？
Right now, I'm really into making vegetable soup. I just throw in whatever leftover veggies I have, so it tastes different every time.
When I stopped by the rental shop, they had way more horror titles in stock. I wonder if it's because I rent them so often？
On weekend nights, I eat dinner a little earlier than usual so I can take a longer bath. Like having a nice soak while reading a magazine.
On my days off, I like to take my time with self-care. Putting on a face pack, shaping my nails...
I was talking on the phone with a friend, and she fell asleep right in the middle of our conversation. Fufu, she must have been tired.
I learned how to make fresh caramel from a cooking show. Hey, do you think you can make cough drops from scratch, too？
Maybe it's better to finish homework before dinner. You always get sleepy after eating, don't you？
I sat down ready to eat, only to realize I'd forgotten to turn on the rice cooker...
I try to watch TV dramas live instead of recording them. Otherwise, my friends spoil everything the next day!
Whenever I watch shopping channels, I always want what's on. It's a real problem...
I keep two kinds of hand cream: scented and unscented. Right now, I'm using one with a lavender scent.
It's always when I have tons of homework that a good movie comes on TV. In the end, I always give in to temptation...
When I can't sleep, I put on a late-night movie, but I almost always drift off. ...And somehow I manage to turn the TV off, too.
Sometimes on days off, I'll rent a bunch of DVDs and watch them all day long. From morning till night. It's my own little luxury♪
I know staying up late is bad for my skin, but I still do it sometimes. I've really got to be careful.
My stereo's acting up, so I wanted to fix it, but I had no clue what to do... If I mess with it, I'll just break it, right？
Do you ever suddenly wake up in the night？ My friends say they do, but rarely me. Guess I'm just a heavy sleeper.
If I get a text while asleep, sometimes I reply without even realizing it. Then I check my phone in the morning and get quite a surprise.
I had such a nice dream. You and I were together, and... Mm, never mind, it's nothing.
I thought I heard a baby crying in the dead of night, but it was just a cat. It really spooked me.
Sometimes I make a teru teru bozu to pray for sunny skies, but by morning its head is drooping down. Maybe its head's just too big...？
I try to go to bed early, but I got totally lost in a book. With romance novels, you just have to know how it ends, you know？
How do you feel about school- work？ Do you hate it like everyone else？
There are all kinds of sports, but do you like moving around and being active？
When it comes to art... Are you interested in making it, or do you just like looking at it？
Are you the type who's particular about fashion？
Do you secretly like cleaning, by any chance？
When it comes to cooking, are you interested in making food, or just eating it？
Hey, do you always do your own laundry？
I've been wondering, are you more of an outdoors person？
They say more people are home- bodies these days. Are you an indoor person too？
There are several parks around town, right？ Spending the whole day relaxing somewhere like that sounds so nice.
Old buildings have such charm, don't they？ What do you think？
Do you like movies？ Old or new, either is fine.
Do you have a favorite sport？ To play, I mean, not just watch.
Hey, do you love to eat？ Maybe you're secretly a huge foodie.
Do you like shopping？ For yourself, I mean, like clothes or shoes？
You don't think girls are way better to photograph than landscapes, do you？
Churches give you this sacred feeling, don't they？ Like they just put your heart at ease...
Do you go see live music very often？
Singing at the top of your lungs feels so good. Do you like doing that？
I've been seeing a lot of people playing games on the train. Are you into gaming too？
Do you like listening to music？
The other day, an anime made me tear up a little. Does that ever happen to you？
I turn into such a kid at amusement parks. Are you like that too？
I'm not much of a swimmer myself... Are you good at it？
The stars are so romantic. Not just the night sky, but the stories behind constellations, too...
Do you like plants？ Are you growing any, by chance？
Do you go to live events often？ Like plays or concerts...？
Do you enjoy going shopping, I wonder？
The sea shows a different face every time you go, so it's neat. Do you like the ocean？
Hey, all boys love seeing girls in swimsuits, don't they？
Aquariums are nice, aren't they？ They're just so full of romance.
Do you like mountains？ Climbing them is great, but just looking at them is nice too.
Animals are so cute, aren't they？ From tiny mice to huge elephants, all of them.
When I was little, I used to play outside in nature a lot. Were you like that too？
Hey, are you a bath lover, I wonder？
There's a movie I want to see. Want to go together sometime？
Riding two on a bike is kind of a dream of mine. You too？
I prefer tea over coffee, myself. Are you a coffee person？
They say space travel might be possible before long. Don't you want to go？
Do you turn in early at night？ Is it okay to text you late？
My shoulders are stiff... Maybe I need more exercise. Are you doing okay？
This mole under my eye, I've had it since I was little. Do you think I should keep it？
Hey, is there anything you'd like to see me wear？
▲主人公＊▲. You like me calling you that, huh？
Sometimes, thinking about you makes my heart race so much that I just can't fall asleep. Does that ever happen to you？
Hey, do you ever get lonely all of a sudden when you're alone？ Like late at night...？
Girls have all kinds of secrets, you know. Hehe, want to know？
Hey... do you think we're being a little too lovey-dovey？
Um, there's no hidden meaning or anything, but... Do you know your ring size？
▲主人公＊▲. Have you ever thought about the future？ About you and me...
Mm, I just felt like asking. Just wondered, is all.
There's no hidden meaning, okay？ I just want to know everything about you, even the little things.
Now I know one more thing about you. I'll remember it, okay？
I just wanted to ask, is all. Thanks for answering.
It's nothing special, really. It just suddenly crossed my mind.
Hehe, the more I learn about you, the more I want to know.
Yeah, I'm glad I asked. I feel like I got a little closer to you.
Come to think of it, I might have asked that before. Hehe.
Sorry for asking the same thing over and over. Maybe you've changed your mind, though？
Did I ask you this before？
Hey, do guys... No, I mean, are you the type to care about size？
Thought so, you're a guy, after all. Hmm, well that's...
I wonder if that's a good thing or not...
So average means... I don't have to worry about it, maybe？
Oh, really. That was a little unexpected...
Um, be honest with me... Do you think I should go on a diet？
Ugh, I knew it... Thanks, I'll think about it, okay？
Really？ You really think so？ Then I'm glad. Hehe.
Lately I get so hungry, I just keep eating. Do you think I'm okay like this？
Really？ But I gained just a little... Hey, if it bothers you, you can tell me, okay？
I see, then that's fine. Do you like girls who eat a lot, maybe？
I knew it... Okay, I'll try to be careful, alright？ Thanks for being honest.
I see. My weight hasn't changed, so I thought it was fine, but... If it bothers you, maybe I'll reconsider.
Hey, what kind of food do you like？
How about food that doesn't fit into one category？
Really？ Then I'll make you something so delicious, your cheeks'll melt right off▼
I see, that'll take some practice... I'll make you something delicious someday, so just wait for me, okay？
Is that so... And here I could've made you something delicious right away.
I'm a little relieved. To be honest, I'm not very good at that.
At the very least, I should be able to proudly call your favorite food my specialty.
Request anything you want, okay？ I might not be able to make it all yet, but someday...
One of these days, I'll get you to say even the foods you dislike are delicious!
I got a new recipe recently. Maybe I'll test it out on you next time？
I found a new recipe. I can't wait to make it for you.
Right now I'm really into Western cooking. I even make the hamburger steak sauce from scratch, you know？
Lately I've gotten into Chinese food. I use authentic seasonings and everything, so it's the real deal.
Japanese food is the classic, after all. I even make the dashi for miso soup from scratch, you know？
It's fun experimenting without sticking to any one genre, too.
Making sweets is my big thing right now. I'm even getting fancy with the wrapping.
What should we do on our next date？ Have you actually already decided？
Really？ That makes me happy. I'm totally ready for your invite, you know？
Then let's decide together. Where I want to go is wherever you want to go.
I wonder if there are places we haven't been to yet.
Snuggling somewhere quiet sounds nice too, hehe.▼
Going somewhere trendy sounds fun too. Even if it might be crowded, though.
The place we went the other day was really nice, too.
I guess somewhere we can be all alone together would be best？
What was the feature in the latest Towano Watcher again？
Oh, how about an indoor date this time？ Somewhere fun where we can stay inside.
Want an outdoor date next time？ Somewhere fun outside.
I wonder if there are any good movies or events going on... How about seeing one？
It might be kind of cliché, but how about shopping？ Is there anything you want？
I'd kind of like to work up a sweat for once. How about you？
For our next date, I'd love to just take it easy. Not doing much of anything, you know？
Let's see... for our next date, somewhere with lots of things to do sounds nice.
Let's do that, then. Of course, if you change your mind, somewhere else is totally fine, okay？
Yeah, if you say so. Honestly, as long as I'm with you, anywhere is fine.
Oh, you have somewhere in mind？ Take me wherever you want, okay？
Yeah, wherever you want to go is fine by me. You can be more selfish with me, you know？
Anywhere is fine with me. As long as I'm with you, anywhere at all.
You don't have to overthink it. It's not like our next date is going to be our last.
Hey, don't you think going straight there after school would be fun？
I'll have to check out some tasty places to eat, too.
Let's go to all kinds of places. Until there's nowhere left we haven't been to.
Reach out anytime, okay？ I'll be waiting.
Thinking about where to go is half the fun, isn't it？
We can't stay out too late like last time, okay？ We are high schoolers, after all.
Hey, what do you think about the girl kissing first？ Do you like that？
Really？ In that case, I might do it all the time... Brace yourself, okay？
So you like it when I take the initiative. It's a bit embarrassing, but maybe I'll give it my all...
So you want to be the one to do it. Well, I'm ready whenever you are, okay？
What a relief. It takes guts for me to do it, and I was a little shy about it...
Hey, do boys prefer doing the kissing rather than being kissed？
Is that so？ You know, I don't mind you being a little forceful with me, either.
I prefer being kissed to doing the kissing, too. ...So don't hold back, okay？
Oh, so you want me to kiss you. Hehe, maybe I'll turn into a kissing monster from now on.
Then I'll kiss you... Though when the moment comes, I feel like I'll get shy.
Um, this might be a strange question, but... where on me do you want to touch the most？
When you pat my head, I feel like a little kid and it relaxes me. Is that weird, since I'm older than you？
It's nice and smooth, right？ I take really good care of it, you know.
I love leaning against you, but having you touch me gently feels so good too.
When we hold hands, I feel like I can sense your feelings through your fingertips and palms.
When you hold me tight, I feel so close to you.
Kissing is something I just never get used to. Every time we do, my heart pounds so hard it feels like it might burst.
Hey, what do you think about feeding each other？
It feels just like being a real couple. Next time, I'll feed you! 'Say ahh!'▼
Then next time, maybe I'll feed you some lunch. Though doing that at school might be a little embarrassing.
If you fed me like that, I'd be so happy. Hehe, just imagining it makes me smile▼
I think it'd be sweet. Come on, humor me and try it just once？
Ah, you think we'd look like silly lovebirds, right？ Give it a shot, you might actually like it, you know？
Are you worried about people watching, maybe？ How about we try it in secret when it's just the two of us？
Hey, have you been sleeping okay lately？
Have you been getting any exercise lately？
Are you eating three proper meals a day？ Breakfast, lunch, and dinner？
You shouldn't snack too much between meals, okay？ You're not overdoing it on junk food, are you？
Even if it's warm at night, mornings get chilly, right？ Are you bundling up when you go to sleep？
Don't catch a chill while sleeping, okay？ Leaving the AC on all night is a big no-no. Understood？
Hey, don't dodge the question. I'm worried about you, so give me a straight answer？
Sheesh, playing dumb now？ Well, as long as you're taking care of yourself, but...
It really worries me when you're like that. Seriously, please take good care of your health, okay？
Good boy, good boy. You're way more responsible than I give you credit for.
That's my guy. You really have things together, don't you？
Looks like you're trying a little. But you've gotta pay more attention than that, okay？
Geez, you really worry me. Take a good look at your habits for once, okay？ Promise me？
Hey, you're gonna ruin your health. If there's anything I can do, I'll help, so let's get you back on track？
No, no, absolutely not. Please, let's fix things, even just one step at a time, okay？
Sleep is more about quality than quantity. If you unwind before bed, you'll sleep so much better, you know？
If you've been using your brain, you need to move your body too. Balance is key. Got it？
You're not skipping breakfast, are you？ Even a glass of milk is fine—make a habit of putting something in your belly.
I get wanting to snack, believe me, but moderation, okay？ I'll work on it with you.
It's easiest to catch a cold while you sleep. Passing out at your computer... don't you dare do that, okay？
It's best to turn off the AC, but at least turn the temp up. Summer colds are nasty, you know？
The place we went today was really wonderful.
Hey, that place we went the other day was so much fun, wasn't it？
The arcade. It was so fun getting to play all those different games together.
You get printed photos, huh？ It makes for a great keepsake, I really love it.
When you win a ton of medals, it really gets you hyped, doesn't it？
The effects were incredible, weren't they？ That jackpot!
We even got scratch cards! I really want to go again.
...Yeah, me too. I love you so much.
What's this all of a sudden？ I love you too, you know？
